$description: Color / Active — danger mode. All values alias the 'danger' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it danger-colored (destructive actions, errors, critical alerts). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'danger'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for danger components

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for danger-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for danger-colored components
